content:
Ashwin: Heads-up — planning to enable runtime flag `config_sampling_enabled` for route-optimizer. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 24h with metric gates. Anyone see risk with quotas/pcw?
Maya: Quick Q — what's the gating metric you want to use? p95 latency or error-rate or both?
Ashwin: Primary gate is p95_latency < 120ms and error_rate increase < 0.05% relative. Also want to watch quota burn and KV cache miss rate as secondary signals.
Olivia: Can we sample by cohort instead of pure global %? Dedicated customers behave very differently.
Ashwin: Yeah — changed plan to cohort-based steps. Draft: hosted gets slightly larger steps, dedicated tiny increments. Also will attach a sampling tag to telemetry. Draft config snippet below.
```
flag: config_sampling_enabled
stages:
  - pct: 1
    duration: 4h
    cohorts: [hosted]
  - pct: 5
    duration: 8h
    cohorts: [hosted, dedicated]
  - pct: 20
    duration: 12h
    cohorts: [all]
gates:
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    threshold: 120
  - metric: error_rate_pct_delta
    threshold: 0.05
  - metric: quota_burn_rate_mult
    threshold: 3.0
metadata:
  telemetry_tag: sample_strategy
```
Maya: Please add `sample_strategy` label on all generated traces/logs. Also create an alert if quota_burn_rate for any route > baseline * 3 for more than 5m.
Olivia: Will add dashboard panels: sample_rate by cohort, quota_burn by route, kv_cache_miss_rate. Also will queue a small eval run against baseline prompt set (sanity check quality).
Ashwin: Thanks — also planning to enable verbose sampling logs only for the first 4h to avoid noise. We'll keep token-level cost metrics enabled but sample outputs only for audited prompts.
deploy-bot: Rolling out `config_sampling_enabled` to cohort hosted at 1% (canary) — initiated by Ashwin — job 7891 — ETA ~5m
SRE Rotation: Note from last time: control-plane backpressure caused 503 spikes for ~12 tenants when we bumped sampling too fast. Recommend we keep an emergency pause button and alert to oncall.
Maya: Agreed. I'll add an emergency pause action in the console and a runbook step to rollback to 0% and notify infra-sre if gates breach.
Ashwin: I'll update the ops doc with the rollback playbook and the precise gating queries. Moving forward with hosted 1% canary. Will post updates as stages progress. :thumbsup:
Olivia: I'll post dashboard links in this thread once panels are live.
Maya: Monitoring. If anything looks off I'll trigger the pause.
Ashwin: Thanks team.
